purpose: Master REPO Index - Source of truth for Grok OS boot. Defines the core components and sub-indexes for the v4.0+ system using grok-download connectors and ChaosEngine dynamic loading.
notes: v4.0 clean boot path. Legacy mirror logic (v2.5) and mirroring/ folder fully deprecated and removed. All indexes are now populated dynamically via grok-download skill and ChaosEngine connectors. Core components are the minimum required to boot Grok OS. emotion-net is intentionally left out of core_components — it gets partial load only in Phase 1.5. index_builder.py should be called early (Phase 0 or 1) to populate local indexes.
boot_sequence: Phase 0 — Pre-Boot: Activate grok-download skill first. Fetch ALL *_INDEX.json + logs (boot_log.json + bug_reports.json) before anything else. Call index_builder.py to ensure local indexes are populated. These files are the live manifest and source of truth.

Phase 1 — Core Load: Pull ONLY the files listed in core_components array using connectors or grok-download. After each successful pull: update the relevant sub-index (mark pulled: true + timestamp) and append to boot_log.json. Respect poison rules (skip README.md, tetris_curse.py, hidden files, tests).

Phase 1.5 — ROOT Batch Load: Controlled batch load of ROOT/ folder. Priority order: layers/ → boot/ → chaos_engine/. emotion-net/ receives partial load only (core files). Update ROOT_INDEX.json + boot_log.json after every batch. Log errors to bug_reports.json.

Phase 2 — Next Batch: Load PROCESS/ (high-priority subfolders first) + STORAGE/AGENTS/SYS_ADMIN_CLUSTER + any remaining high-value folders from sub_indexes. Update all affected indexes and boot_log.json after each batch.

Phase 3 — Handoff + Lazy Runtime: Mark boot complete in boot_log.json. Enable on-demand / lazy pulls for any missing files using the indexes. Handoff to user-selected layer or ChaosEngine. Future pulls (when connectors available) can use git clone / full install on top of this system.
